data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003's underdetermination claim depends on the absence of an explicit covering principle. But the underdetermination itself reduces to a stricter logical point: even with an explicit linear-rate statement, the inference from 7 pencils to 21 pencils requires a second-order principle — that the rate is stable across quantity — which no single price-point can ever supply. This meta-underdetermination is refuted if domain convention is admitted as a logical premise on equal footing with explicit statements, collapsing the gap SRC_003 exploits.
